metadata.description:
# Perfect Sound
Professional REAPER toolkit. Requires a valid Perfect Sound license.
Visit https://perfectsound.example to purchase a license. After install, run any Perfect Sound action from the Action List - you will be prompted for your email and password on first run.
All scripts are streamed from the licensing server, decrypted in memory, and never written to disk. Installing a script without a valid license will simply do nothing when run.

The Perfect Sound loader. Required by every Perfect Sound script. Install this first.
On first run, prompts for the email and password tied to your license. Credentials are cached locally encrypted with a hardware-bound key, so copying the cache file to another machine does not transfer the license.

version.author: Perfect Sound
version.changelog: Initial release of the v2 loader.

metadata.description:
Specs - inspect scenes, regions and markers in your project.
Requires a Perfect Sound license that includes the Specs script. Without authorization, running this action will silently do nothing.

Releases this computer's Perfect Sound license binding.
Use this when you want to move your license to another computer in a clean way (recommended before selling, lending, or formatting this machine). After deactivating, just sign in normally on the new computer.
You do NOT need this script for the normal case of moving between two computers - simply running any Perfect Sound script on the new machine and signing in will release the previous device automatically.

Search for text inside session items.
Requires a Perfect Sound license that includes the Script Text Finder.

Quality control toolkit for VO/LOC/ALT items, with LUFS and TP analysis.
Requires a Perfect Sound license that includes the QA Tool.
